req.title: Reject player with duplicate squadNumber
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 409 Conflict when the squadNumber in a new player already belongs to another player.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-008 requires HTTP 409 Conflict when a POST /players/ request carries a squadNumber already owned by an existing player. The test suite covers: (1) a positive case confirming a brand-new squadNumber is accepted with HTTP 201; (2) a negative/EP case confirming an exact duplicate squadNumber returns HTTP 409 with the correct detail message; (3) a boundary/STC case that first creates a player (state: exists) then immediately retries the same payload to confirm the transition from 'not-exists' to 'exists' triggers 409; (4) a DT case combining duplicate squadNumber with otherwise-different field values to confirm the conflict check is solely on squadNumber; (5) a BVA case using squadNumber=1 (lowest pre-loaded value) to confirm the boundary value itself triggers 409. All tests use FastAPI TestClient in-process, assert exact status codes and response body fields, and are idempotent against the pre-loaded fixture database.

tests.name: test_post_new_squad_number_returns_201
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with 26 players using squadNumbers 1-26
squadNumber 99 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with a valid payload using squadNumber=99
expected: Response body contains a valid UUID id field
trace: R-PLAYER-008: happy-path — unique squadNumber must be accepted
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_new_squad_number_returns_201():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["firstName"] == "Test"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert "id" in body
    assert len(body["id"]) == 36

preconditions: squadNumber=10 belongs to Kabir Mary Reddy (pre-loaded row)
actions: POST /players/ with squadNumber=10 (already exists in DB)
expected: Response detail contains 'A Player with this squad number already exists.'
trace: R-PLAYER-008: error pathway — duplicate squadNumber must yield 409

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

    payload = {

tests.name: test_post_then_duplicate_triggers_409_state_transition
preconditions: squadNumber=50 does not exist in the database
actions: POST /players/ with squadNumber=50 (first call — state: not-exists)
POST /players/ with squadNumber=50 again (second call — state: exists)
expected: Second POST returns HTTP 409 with exact detail message
trace: R-PLAYER-008: state transition from 'squadNumber absent' to 'squadNumber present' must trigger 409 on retry
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_then_duplicate_triggers_409_state_transition():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Alpha",
        "lastName": "Beta",
        "squadNumber": 50,
        "position": "Goalkeeper"
    }
    r1 = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r1.status_code == 201
    body1 = r1.json()
    assert body1["squadNumber"] == 50

    r2 = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r2.status_code == 409
    body2 = r2.json()
    assert body2["detail"] == "A Player with this squad number already exists."

tests.name: test_409_response_does_not_contain_201_status
preconditions: squadNumber=15 belongs to Priya Chopra (pre-loaded row)
expected: HTTP status code is exactly 409, not 201 or any 2xx
Response body has 'detail' key with exact conflict message
trace: R-PLAYER-008: confirms the status code is precisely 409 and not accidentally 201; catches status-code constant mutations
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_409_response_does_not_contain_201_status():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Priya",
        "lastName": "Chopra",
        "squadNumber": 15,
        "position": "Left-Back"
    }
    r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 409
    assert r.status_code != 201
    assert r.status_code != 200
    body = r.json()
    assert "detail" in body
    assert body["detail"] == "A Player with this squad number already exists."
